title: Constraining the Tilted Dipole Cosmology with Primordial Nucleosynthesis and Baryogenesis
summary: The tilted dipole cosmology extends the standard model by incorporating a preferred spatial direction and separate bulk velocities for matter and radiation, offering a potential explanation for observed large-scale bulk flows and the CMB dipole. We conduct a comprehensive analysis of this anisotropic framework using Big Bang Nucleosynthesis (BBN) and Gravitational Baryogenesis (GB) to impose stringent constraints on the radiation tilt parameter $β_r$, which quantifies the magnitude of the radiation bulk flow.
